# Keep Essence / KeepEssence (精华)

> Save a lot. Keep only the essence. An assistant reads what you save first and tells you what it says and whether it is worth your time; whether to keep it or dig deeper is up to you. In beta, open only to invited emails.

## Canonical URLs
- English homepage: https://www.keepessence.app/
- Chinese homepage: https://www.keepessence.app/zh/
- Remote MCP endpoint: https://keepessence.app/mcp

## What KeepEssence Is
KeepEssence is a reading inbox with an assistant that reads first. You save; the assistant tells you what each item says and whether it is worth your time; you decide what to keep. It can also connect to an assistant you already use, if that assistant supports remote MCP.

1. **Save**: Paste a link, text or an image into the web app (it opens in a browser on a computer or a phone). On a computer, a browser extension for Chromium-based browsers saves the current page in one click; it is installed by hand, is not in any store yet, and the steps come with your invitation.
2. **Four-line analysis**: Within a few minutes the built-in assistant writes four lines: a summary, a key fact, up to three key points, and a verdict.
3. **Daily digest**: After 9 PM in your time zone, a one-page digest is written: what is worth a deep dive, the rest, and a question to sleep on, ending with `Read. Good night`. It picks from items that have been processed (including any that couldn't be analysed) and haven't been in a digest yet, up to a set limit per digest, so it can include items from earlier days. Not everything saved that day is sure to be in it; items not deleted may appear in a later digest, on no set day.
4. **Deep dive and notes**: Pick what is worth it, talk it through with an assistant, and keep it as your own note. Notes have a quick find and can be downloaded as Markdown. On a day you keep a note, the calendar shows a gold dot.
5. **Pages that cannot be read**: Some pages (for example ones that ask you to sign in or verify) cannot be fetched. KeepEssence then says "Content could not be fetched" and links the original instead of guessing.

## What Works Today (beta)
- Yes: the web app on computer and phone browsers; the browser extension in Chromium-based browsers (tested in Chromium only; not yet tried in Chrome, Edge and Brave one by one); the built-in assistant's analyses and daily digest; notes; connecting your own assistant over MCP.
- Not yet: the iPhone app is not open for installation.

## Remote MCP Integration
- **Endpoint**: `https://keepessence.app/mcp` (the same for all users; it is an address, not a credential).
- You approve each assistant on KeepEssence's approval page.
- A standard remote MCP client has been connected end to end on the live service. Specific assistant products have not each been tested; whether yours works depends on its own MCP support.
- No assistant of your own is needed: the built-in assistant writes the analyses and the daily digest.

## Pricing
- The built-in assistant is free during the beta. Nothing beyond the beta has been announced.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Do I need my own AI assistant?** No. The built-in assistant writes the analyses and the daily digest.
- **Is there a phone app?** Not yet for installation. Use the web app in your phone's browser.
- **Can anyone sign up?** Not yet. The beta is open only to invited emails; you can apply on the homepage.
